canonical_spec.title: Teaching portfolio
canonical_spec.outcome: Design, teach and assess coherent undergraduate and graduate material.
canonical_spec.deliverables: Syllabi, sample lessons, assessments/rubrics, observed-teaching protocol and supervision plan requiring human observation.

architecture: Distinct cross-volume capstone for ACTUAL learner teaching and supervision evidence. V17project and chapter dossiers are synthetic rehearsal; link their complete exemplars, do not copy or represent them as actual learner delivery. Include one h1 for assembled standalone crossassessment, otherwise appropriate structured sections.

Operational artifact groups: own complete undergraduate and graduate syllabi with audience/prerequisite/reading/workload/assessment alignment; substantive full sample lessons and original assessments/keys/rubrics with actual permitted learner work and grading/feedback; actually delivered teaching demonstration(s) with qualified independent human observation and learner evidence; concrete supervision plan and substantive feedback/revision/assistance records, declaring planned versus actual activities; reflective portfolio/claim-evidence map and actual external review/defense. Require a real observed teaching session and both levels of coherent design; define exact scope of observed level and do not infer observation of the other. No requirement may be silently satisfied by library templates.

Complete reusable candidate and assessor forms with blank/not-observed fields for actual evidence, provenance, roles, permissions, version, assistance, conflicts and reviewer judgment. Full gate distinctions design/delivery/performance/retention/causal effect; no weighted score can substitute for missing actual observation, incorrect economics, fabricated work or unaddressed material objections. Qualitative anchored judgments and advance/revise/not-ready decisions; workload/timing internal and uncalibrated.

Staged eligibility/submission, expert and conflict review, inspection of full course/materials/actual work, preobservation agreement, real teaching observation, feedback/revision, independent transfer where appropriate, defense and final disposition. Actual privacy/access/institutional rules must be verified locally, no promised confidentiality/approval. Disagreements documented with evidence and additional qualified review, not averaged into fake consensus.

At least three complete ORIGINAL assessor-calibration cases with self-contained substantive economic/financial teaching tasks/full keys, supplied learner responses/scoring or supervision proofs, complete observer/reviewer statements and full disposition/response memos. Cases must be distinct from C12 ceiling/auction, exams tax/identification and bond/repayment, and project public-good provision. Suggested statuses: strong design but missing observation; actually stipulated observed session with consequential wrong key/feedback requiring repair; narrower conditional readiness with real stipulated feedback and independent changed response while broad efficacy remains unproven. All explicitly fictional; at least one nontrivial full derivation/counterexample, meaningful numerical boundary/alternative checks. Artifacts and full reasoned decisions required, not rubric-only examples.

Map both prerequisite volumes V16/V17 and all12V17chapters to exact capability gates/remediation. Full operational defense questions, support/prompting conditions and example complete responses; separate invitation from actual review and future revision from implemented evidence. Preserve source inspector attribution. Reuse bounded source records, retrieve only unresolved specialist facts.
